utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would really help—I just want to be sure the timing and who’s bringing what are both clear so nothing slips through.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep reminding folks and pass along any updates I hear, and I’ll help make sure who’s bringing what stays clear too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that makes me feel better. If you can keep the updates simple and confirm the timing and items, I think we’ll stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still waiting on the date and the repair list before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That makes sense—I’ll stop by after errands and see if they’ve posted the date and repair list yet.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — please let me know if you find both the date and the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in — just send me the time and where to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape and spare gloves, and I can bring a couple screwdrivers too — I’ll drop them by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—just leave them at my porch when you can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I can sort the tools and hand out the flyers, and we can start with the porch step first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — the porch step first, right. Thanks, Mara; I’ll grab the tools and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Noah — I’ll bring the flyers and get the tools sorted. See you at the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact meeting spot and what we should bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s meet at my place by the front steps after lunch. Bring gloves and any screws or small parts you already have.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — front steps after lunch, and I’ll bring gloves and any screws I have.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much can you spare, and when should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can spare a basic wrench set and a screwdriver kit; that sounds most useful. Come by tomorrow afternoon, and I’ll have it ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — I’ll stop by tomorrow afternoon. Thanks for setting aside the wrench set and screwdriver kit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly hands-on help, a few tools, and some extra supplies like screws and tape. I can keep an ear out for the full list if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please — could you keep an ear out for the date and the full repair list? That would help me a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll ask around for the date and the full repair list and let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on — I’ll bring the tools over after lunch and we can start with the porch step.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Leo — after lunch works great. I’ll be ready at the porch step when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll see you at the porch step after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—send me the stops and I’ll keep the list organized. I’m also still noting the drop-off spot and the community hall deadline for the labeled boxes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll send the stops over as soon as I have the list. Thanks for keeping track of the drop-off spot and deadline too!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course—once you send the stops, I’ll keep everything neatly organized and make sure the community hall drop-off stays on track for 4.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mostly hands-on help, a few tools, and some extra supplies like screws and tape. I can keep an ear out for the full list if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that’d help — just keep me posted on the full list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know as soon as I hear the full list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve checked what we have, and we’re still short on screws and a few more rags. I’ll bring the tape, spare gloves, and screwdrivers by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you, Cleo. I’ll add screws and rags to the list and keep everything organized for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rosa — I’ll drop off the tape, gloves, and screwdrivers, and I’ll keep an eye out for any more supplies we might need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still not totally sure on the date yet, but I heard the repair drive is coming up soon. I don’t have the full list of what needs fixing either.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: No worries — once you have the date, send it my way and I’ll work it around pickup. If you get the list of repairs too, I can help line things up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll pass along the date and repair list as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I’ll bring a basic wrench set and a screwdriver kit. I’m writing it down now so I actually remember.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — that should keep things organized. If you can note the time and where we’re dropping things off, I’ll feel much better about it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ve got it noted: the time and drop-off spot too. I’d better write it twice so I don’t wander off and forget again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep reminding folks and pass along any updates I hear. We’ll make sure the repair drive gets good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and let people know what I hear. I’m still not totally sure on the date or the full details, though.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep repeating the plan and share any date or details as soon as I hear them. And I’ll remind folks to bring any tools they can spare for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the exact meeting spot and a short bring list so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so what’s the exact spot and the short list again?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m checking that now and I’ll send the exact spot plus a short bring list so it’s clear for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good—I’ll stop by after errands and report back on anything they’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll check in too and help make sure both groups are on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll swing by after errands and let you know what they’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there at 9 with my gloves. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you Saturday at 9:00 AM.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 9:00 with my gloves. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — we still need the drop-off spot sorted and the labeled boxes taken to the community hall by 4. If you remind me, I can help get it moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—send me the drop-off spot and any other stops, and I’ll keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check the usual spots and send you the drop-off place, plus any extra stops I spot. Thanks for keeping it organized — I’m a bit scattered today.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort donations or hand out tools? We could also use someone to help folks sign up for repairs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I can help sort donations and hand out tools, and I can also help people sign up for repairs if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Sam — thank you. I’ll put you on all three, and we’ll get everything moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can spare a little, but I need to keep it quiet and simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much can you spare, and when should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can manage a small amount, and you can come by later today if that works quietly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start spreading the word on the block for extra hands and tools. Send me the stops when you have them, and I’ll pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send over the stops as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll keep an ear out and start asking around for anyone with tools or free time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli—I'll bring what I can and help sort things in order.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Dane. Just keep it simple and we’ll handle it in order.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll swing by with what I’ve got and keep it simple.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
